adaptive_preference.rationale: If shorter recency is functionally indistinguishable on the actual betting target, prefer 365 days for faster adaptation to changing established-player talent/arsenal while recognizing it does not solve sparse-history players by itself.
adaptive_preference.replication_guardrail: If the pre-replication preferred challenger worsens 2026 versus 730 by more than 0.00010 log loss/game or 0.00005 Brier/game, retain 730.

future_test_if_365_and_730_indistinguish: Test support-adaptive recency as a separate precommitted experiment; do not introduce it inside Phase 31B.
